enable_conv2d_gradfix: set the enabled global flag to true to activate the custom conv2d gradient fix
use_conv2d: call conv2d with input weight and optional bias stride padding dilation and groups arguments
use_conv_transpose2d: call conv_transpose2d with input weight and optional bias stride padding output_padding groups and dilation
use_no_weight_gradients: use the no_weight_gradients context manager to temporarily disable weight gradient computation
check_custom_op: call _should_use_custom_op with a cuda tensor to check if the custom op will be used
